name: a-budget-counts-every-turn
description: SPEC.md 4.10: a token bound is enforced against what the run ACTUALLY consumes, turn after turn - not against the first turn's figure replayed. Here every turn's prompt grows by a long observation, so the true cumulative spend crosses the bound within a few turns while an implementation that measures only the first turn and re-bills it stays far under the bound, runs to the turn cap, and returns the tool output instead of the exhaustion. The expected result is the budget stopping the loop, distinguishably.
